with_cinder.speaker: cinder
with_cinder.text: The end of the thread. Not a Key; the place a Key was, and something of me wound round the absence. I could cut here and be nobody's, or leave it and keep remembering. I would like to be asked.

choices.text: Leave it, and let us go.
Cut it. Nobody should be tied to an absence.

asked.speaker: cinder
asked.text: To remember. It is the only thing I was for. Thank you for asking; nobody has, in four hundred years.

alone.speaker: player
alone.text: A thread of Weft wound round nothing, taut. Something at the other end used to be here.

dead.speaker: player
dead.text: The end of Cinder's thread, slack now. He wanted to be asked. You ask the absence, out loud, and leave it.
